reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified restriction to the north region only. In the full sample the training coefficient is about 0.80 (p<0.001), and about 0.84 with full controls. It is concentrated in the south (about 1.80, p<0.001), so the north-only null isn't representative. The report also treats a non-significant result as proof of no effect.
